# Spoken mobile test fixture

`mobile-voice-en.wav` contains the word “Hello.” generated by Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (`en-US-Standard-C`, speaking rate 1.15, LINEAR16 at 16000 Hz) on 2026-09-08. The 615.25 ms output is padded with silence to exactly 1000 ms. No real microphone or user recording is included.

SHA-256: `92bb7f07a1d1f95bf037dd805f3d5d06fb837a72839698e2b5f10674f095cf33`.

The old periodic signal is retained as `mobile-voice-periodic-base.wav` solely for the historical alignment regression. A non-silent tone is not a reliable real-speech ASR fixture; GCP correctly rejected captures of that fixture with `VOICE_SPEECH_NOT_RECOGNIZED`.
